contextReview.basis: Direct review: overcast daytime East Asian urban streets with small tiled building walls, shop windows, canvas awnings, potted plants, parked scooters and brick or stone paving; no rain depicted and reflective paving is not read as rain; white reflective details catch the direct flash; humidity not inferred. Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

casting.castingPolicy: mixed adult model appearance independent of the East Asian urban location (user 2026-11-03)

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The twig caught in the laces is a scene prop, not a product. The man stands with one foot raised on a stone ledge: the top's back, the shorts' hidden leg and the tights' waist are conservatively reconstructed. The black zip pouch is seen from the front, with its full webbing and buckle inferred. The gray shorts and navy tights are separate products. Both shoes are visible and listed as one pair. Brand, fibre composition, performance and retail identity are unknown.

deck.ko: 코발트 긴소매와 네이비 타이츠의 깊은 색.
deck.en: Cobalt sleeves meet deep navy tights.
deck.de: Kobaltblaue Ärmel treffen auf tiefe Marinetights.

intro.ko: 한 발을 낮은 턱에 올려 신발끈에 걸린 가지를 떼어 냅니다.
intro.en: He raises one foot onto a low curb to remove a twig caught in the shoelace.
intro.de: Er stellt einen Fuß auf eine niedrige Kante und entfernt einen Zweig aus der Schnürung.

body.ko: 코발트 상의의 흰 위팔 띠가 숙인 몸의 방향을 보여줍니다. 회색 쇼츠 아래 네이비 타이츠가 이어지고 회색 양말과 메시 러닝화가 단정한 끝을 만듭니다. 검정 지퍼 허리 파우치는 몸 앞에 붙어 손동작을 비워 둡니다.
body.en: White upper-arm bands trace the cobalt top across the bent torso. Navy tights extend below gray shorts to gray socks and mesh runners. A black zip waist pouch stays close at the front and leaves both hands free.
body.de: Weiße Oberarmbänder folgen dem kobaltblauen Shirt am gebeugten Oberkörper. Unter grauen Shorts reicht die Marinetight zu grauen Socken und Mesh-Laufschuhen. Eine schwarze Zip-Hüfttasche bleibt vorne körpernah und lässt beide Hände frei.

pull.en: Two layers stay distinct at the bent knee.
pull.de: Zwei Lagen bleiben am gebeugten Knie getrennt.

copy.pullQuoteEn: Two layers stay distinct at the bent knee.

tip.ko: 가지를 제거한 뒤 끈 매듭과 양말 앞부분을 다시 정리하세요.
tip.en: Recheck the knot and smooth the sock after removing the twig.
tip.de: Nach dem Entfernen den Knoten prüfen und die Socke glätten.
